set_aside.subject: advance_run guarded edges sourced from flow inputs
set_aside.text: flow inputs delivered along every edge from them — a flow input or flow output endpoint is the node whose node_id is the empty string (A05 rule 2), never the flow_id —
set_aside.other_text: an edge is disabled only once its source node concluded succeeded and its guard port's value differs from the guard value; an edge whose source has not concluded is neither enabled nor disabled, so a port with such an edge can still receive a value
set_aside.question: Must an edge sourced from a flow input be delivered without a source-node conclusion, or must it remain neither enabled nor disabled because a flow-input endpoint never concludes?
